# Halloway Ridge Programme Timeline

**Authority:** secondary — programme office record
**Compiled:** 2031-03-13

| Date | Event |
| --- | --- |
| 2029-06-10 | Sensor Specification Revision 1 takes effect. |
| 2030-09-02 | First TX-40 units installed at Halloway Ridge. |
| 2030-09-19 | Installation of all 42 units complete. |
| 2030-11-05 | Permit MPAB-2030-4417 issued by the Board. |
| 2031-01-06 | First drift observation logged by Tobias Quell. |
| 2031-01-08 | Firmware 4.2.1 released. |
| 2031-01-20 | Distributor Bulletin DB-2031-07 circulated. |
| 2031-02-01 | Sensor Specification Revision 2 takes effect; Revision 1 superseded. |
| 2031-02-24 | Last drift observation of the reporting window. |
| 2031-03-11 | Review meeting held; verbatim extracts certified. |
| 2031-08-30 | Board decision expected (not yet issued). |

## Notes

- The drift observation window runs from 2031-01-06 to 2031-02-24 inclusive.
- The Board decision date is an expectation, not a commitment, and the trial
  outcome remains subject to regulatory approval.
